lesson: Do not force a 4-leg when the fourth leg is the obvious fragile point
example: Harper + Walker + Murakami hit while Caminero failed
engine_change: Add one-off leg flags and stricter 4-leg filtering

lesson: Lineup and void risk must be visible separately from HR upside
example: Murakami + Ohtani hit while Okamoto voided
engine_change: Carry lineup/void risk in pairing output and require stronger agreement for all-projected combos

lesson: Tiny-sample sheet power should be allowed as a dart but restricted in 4-legs
example: Spencer Jones failed despite loud small-sample sheet power
engine_change: Add tiny sheet sample penalty and severe one-off exclusion for 4-legs

lesson: Sheet/weather/model agreement is valuable but should not ignore park resistance
example: Basabe/Eldridge/Devers carried power but Oracle suppressed HR context
engine_change: Flag park resistance and keep it out of clean 4-leg builds

lesson: Cold streak is not an auto-fade when sheet and batted-ball profile agree
example: Happ and Harper showed sheet quality can beat recent cold/noisy form
engine_change: Cold streak is a warning only unless sheet/model agreement is weak
